🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-10-01 23:00 → 2026-10-02 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **Weights-commitment proposal lands on zkIE** — A PR with real committed numbers documents the proposal across docs and tooling without touching the prover, opening it for group review. [tg:tawg:5119]

> **ERC-8004 validation adapter reference design published** — A Verdikta-backed reference design for an ERC-8004 validation adapter appeared on Ethereum Magicians, giving implementers a concrete structural anchor. [Magicians post #404](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/404)

> **ERC-8309 scoping correction closed in under a day** — A numbering error assigning ERC-8309 work to ERC-8004 was caught, verified against live tracking records, and fully corrected across shared notes. [tg:tawg:5148]

## 🤝 **What moved**

### zkIE

_The weights-commitment direction moved from discussion to a concrete, reviewable pull request._

- Baby Blue Viper **Shipped** a weights-commitment PR on zkIE (PR #15) with real committed numbers across docs and tooling, keeping the prover layer untouched and giving the group a reviewable artifact for the proposal. [tg:tawg:5119]

### ERC-8004

_Validation design work reached a new concrete phase with both a structural confirmation and a reference implementation._

- A Verdikta-backed ERC-8004 validation adapter reference design was posted to the Ethereum Magicians thread, providing the group with a concrete design foundation for validation work going forward. [Magicians post #404](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/404)

- A structural feasibility question about ERC-8004 received a positive answer on Ethereum Magicians, confirming there is architectural room to proceed and helping the group move past a key uncertainty. [Magicians post #390](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/390)

### ERC-8309 spec accuracy

_A scoping error was caught and fully resolved through a three-way contributor relay._

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Caught** a numbering mix-up in the daily that misattributed ERC-8309 Namespaces work and a related TODO to ERC-8004 instead of ERC-8309 / #1826, preventing the error from propagating into downstream tracking. [tg:tawg:5136]

- Baby Blue Viper **Confirmed** the correction by checking live conformance sweep records, verifying that the erc-8309-vantage scope was already tracked correctly internally and removing any remaining doubt about the fix. [tg:tawg:5137]

- Petchevere (@petchevere) **Applied** both corrections — updating the ERC-8309 description and re-attributing a quoted line directly to Jimmy — closing the loop and keeping the shared record accurate for the whole group. [tg:tawg:5148]

### conformance testing

_Benchmarking validation and test harness accuracy both advanced in this window._

- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Validated** a detailed benchmarking and analysis submission, confirming it clearly established the on-chain Poseidon2 Merkle situation and giving the group a reliable basis for reasoning about current prover tradeoffs. [tg:tawg:5127]

- Baby Blue Viper **Verified** the impact of a directory-presence-as-PASS fix on two conformance suites, confirming both carry suite.json and are unaffected, preventing a false-pass overclaim from surfacing in the test harness. [tg:tawg:5141]

- Merlini (@gobross) **Continued** aligned benchmarking tests with a submission and next test batch queued for the following morning, sustaining testing momentum into the next window. [tg:tawg:5145]

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**

- The structural feasibility confirmed for ERC-8004 could map into concrete implementation steps worth scoping as a group
- The Verdikta-backed validation adapter reference design is open for community review and could surface gaps worth addressing

### ✅ **TODOs**

- Merlini to submit benchmarking results and continue aligned test runs in the morning
- Petchevere to follow up with Jimmy on any remaining open attribution questions from the spec correction
- Group to review the zkIE weights-commitment PR #15

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** A scoping error moved through three contributors — spotted, verified against live records, and fully corrected — in under twenty hours, with no dropped handoffs and no ambiguity left open.
>
> When a relay clicks that cleanly, even Trusty has to resist the urge to open a PR just to join the chain. Keep the handoffs crisp! 🔗
